raw_text:
PLAN "Post-Illness Reconditioning Block"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Return to pre-illness strength: bench 100, squat 140, deadlift 170"
  GOAL secondary recovery:
    name "Rebuild lost bodyweight and work capacity after illness"

PHASES
  PHASE "Reconditioning" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Squat Focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Hinge Focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body Base":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Squat Focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Hinge Focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x5..6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          ab_rollout 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full Body Build":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Squat Focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          cable_row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Hinge Focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 5x3..5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up 3x5..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          ab_rollout 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full Body Strength":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          overhead_press 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

goals.name: Return to pre-illness strength: bench 100, squat 140, deadlift 170
Rebuild lost bodyweight and work capacity after illness
